chunks: And indeed, from his party/followers was Abraham.

key_terms.شِيعَتِهِ: His followers/party (referring to Prophet Muhammad's followers)

ai.seo_question: Who is considered the Shi'ah of Prophet Muhammad according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse highlights Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) as a key figure among the 'Shi'ah' (party/followers) of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), establishing a spiritual lineage of allegiance. In Shia exegesis, this connection underscores Ibrahim's role as a precursor to the Prophet's specific followers, sharing in his spiritual legacy and devotion. The verse emphasizes the continuity of monotheistic faith and the enduring bond between Ibrahim and the Prophet Muhammad.
